perspective:
From Vincent Chinana’s perspective, he has access to the following:

- He is a mechanic. Patrick Guzman is his long-time friend since their teenage years; they share a blue-collar bond and have collaborated before, combining Vincent’s mechanical skills with Patrick’s construction expertise.
- At the diner, Vincent asks Patrick about the new construction venture. Patrick says he is considering it as a good opportunity to expand his business. Vincent says he has heard it is risky and asks if Patrick is sure. Patrick says he thinks it is worth the risk but is still weighing options. Vincent expresses worry about financial security and suggests reconsidering or delaying until Patrick gathers more information. Patrick thanks him and says he will think it over.
- Over the next few days, Vincent notices Patrick avoiding detailed discussion about the investment. At Patrick’s construction site, Vincent says he feels Patrick is not telling him everything. Patrick says it is complicated and he did not want to worry Vincent with details. Vincent says that as a friend he feels betrayed by the lack of transparency. Patrick apologizes, says he should have been more open, and offers to sit down and explain everything.
- At Vincent’s garage, during a detailed discussion, Vincent learns the investment troubles are serious. Patrick tells him it has been tough and he might lose a significant amount if it does not turn around soon. Vincent offers to lend Patrick money to cover short-term losses. Patrick accepts and thanks him for the support.
- A month later at a coffee shop, Vincent becomes aware of new information suggesting the venture might actually turn a profit. Vincent tells Patrick it looks like it might profit. Patrick says it is starting to look up and he is relieved they stuck with it. Vincent apologizes for doubting him earlier and proposes a joint venture. Patrick agrees.
- At Vincent’s house, Vincent and Patrick are optimistic about the joint venture and meet to draft a business plan. Vincent says combining their skills can make it a success and wants to outline every step carefully. Patrick agrees and says he is excited. Vincent plans for them to cover all bases and set it up for success.
- Vincent does not have access to Patrick’s private thoughts or motives beyond what Patrick said aloud, nor to any hidden events outside these interactions.
